Maya: Morning caffeine check-in — ticket snapshot: 48 open (↑6 since last shift). Quick notes:
- Known issue: webhook retries causing duplicate events from EU garden orgs. Seen spikes in eu-west-1.
- Macros: updated `refund-ack` and queued a small tweak for `billing-refund`.
- PR/pings: @Jon please review #302 (refund edgecases).

Jon: Saw the webhook spike overnight. I pushed a temporary backoff to the retry queue; should cut dupes. Will review #302 today, ETA EOD. :thumbsup:

Eli: Added a quick dashboard for webhook latency (Alerts -> Webhooks > eu-west-1). Link: https://grafana.internal/r/webhooks-eu-west-1. I also opened a metric to count idempotency failures (order_id missing).

Priya: Small macro request — can we include `{{customer_id}}` in `refund-ack` so agents have an immediate lookup? Example suggestion:
```
Refund processed for order {{order_id}} (customer {{customer_id}}). If you need further help, reply with ticket number.
```
I'll push the edit once y'all 👍.

Luca: I'm covering on-call this morning. I'm seeing a cluster of ~20 tickets from the same org (automation). Triage underway, grouping into one parent ticket for ES callee. If rate limit continues, will spin an infra page.

SupportBot: Alert: webhooks_latency > 2000ms in eu-west-1 for 14m. Ticket surge +23 in the last 30m. Incident flag: potential downstream queue saturation.

Maya: Action items recap:
- Jon: review & merge #302 (refund edgecases).
- Priya: push macro change for `refund-ack` and post macro ID here.
- Luca: triage EU surge, escalate to infra if >30% error rate.
- Eli: keep dashboard/watchdog and annotate incidents.
Also: if anyone adds or edits macros, add one-line description to the Macros doc (Confluence -> Support -> Macros).

Jon: ack, taking #302 now.

Priya: Will push macro in a few mins and paste `/macro id 583-refund-ack` when done.

Luca: Starting grouped ticket and will post updates here.

Maya: Thanks team — ping here for any quick handoffs. Coffee emoji for those who made it this far :coffee:
